question:
Which of the following fractions is the largest?

(7)/(9),(6)/(7),frac{{22}}{{25}}, and frac{{11}}{{13}}
solution:
**Given:**

**(7)/(9),(6)/(7),frac{{22}}{{25}}, frac{{11}}{{13}}**

**Concept Used:**

Simplify the fractions into decimal digits.

**Calculation:**

⇒ 7/9 = 0.77

⇒ 6/7 = 0.85

⇒ 22/25 = 0.88

⇒ 11/13 = 0.84

The largest value is 0.88 which can be fractionalized into 22/25.

**∴ The largest fraction is 22/25.**
